title: Reading What Is Still Standing on a Healthy Options Card at Closure
content:
What is still standing on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card at its closure is read from the card record, from the card record together with money put back, or entry by entry from the card's own running record, according to what that record holds.

**When the figure is fixed.** The balance given up on the closing day is not fixed until every card transaction at a dental, vision or hearing provider that the member's other cover has since paid its part of carries on the card the money put back for it.

**The rule.** What is still standing on the card is worked out entry by entry from the card's own record, being the loads and the money put back less the transactions that settled and less what has already been taken off, where the card carries a transaction the network refused or one authorised and not yet settled; it is the balance the card record shows together with the money put back for purchases the member questioned, where the card carries no such transaction but carries such money put back; and it is the balance the card record shows in every other case.

| What the card's record holds | What is still standing on the card |
|---|---|
| a transaction the network refused, or one authorised and not yet settled | the loads and the money put back, less the transactions that settled and less what has already been taken off, worked out entry by entry |
| no such transaction, but money put back for a purchase the member questioned | the balance the card record shows together with that money put back |
| neither | the balance the card record shows |

**What each part means.** The loads are the scheduled and extra load entries on the card. The money put back is every entry returning money to the card, whatever its reason. The transactions that settled are the purchases with a settled standing. What has already been taken off the card is the quantity of that name.

**Worked through on hypothetical entries.** A card showing loads of 270.00 USD, money put back of 19.99 USD, settled purchases of 95.00 USD, nothing already taken off, and one purchase the network refused: what is still standing is 194.99 USD, worked out entry by entry. Strike the refused purchase and leave a questioned-purchase credit of 19.99 USD standing, with a card record balance of 175.00 USD: what is still standing is 194.99 USD. Strike both, with a card record balance of 175.00 USD: what is still standing is 175.00 USD.
